We started with describing them by color and I immediately recognized some obvious differences in the hats, arms and shoes. Once we figured out a plan of starting at the top and working downward, it became much simpler. The final task was the most difficult because there was the most variance, so we added a 1-10 scale rating for height, but a bit more time to agree on heights would have been beneficial.

Also note that I didn't use hte Report Bugs button, but there were multiple times throughout the study where I noticed words disappeared from my textbox after I typed (it just did it in this note box at the end lmao - deleted like the last 3 words I typed). I asked my partner, and he said it happened to him as well - so that definitely accounts for some of our mistakes! We shouldve gotten more points if not for bugs lol

prompt_working_together.value: I kind of dominated the discussion but I am naturally charismatic and I consider myself fairly intelligent. Once I had gotten my partner's agreement in our system, having him read out the names while I typed them worked very well. I also noticed he was having some typing issues at the first round, so by taking over that role - I sped up our ability to discuss, and he could look more at the images and less at his keyboard.
